mapper.sql: select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, max_retry, retry_count, next_retry_time, recover_count, request_json, error_code, error_message, callback_event_id, create_time from ai_video_generation_task
mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_generation_task (project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, priority, idempotency_key, provider_code, model_code, progress, max_retry, request_json, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{assetId}, #{taskType}, #{taskName}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{providerCode}, #{modelCode}, #{progress}, #{maxRetry}, #{requestJson}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress from ai_video_generation_task where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
where task_id = #{taskId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) for update
where task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and (idempotency_key = #{keyPrefix} or idempotency_key like concat(#{keyPrefix}, '-%')) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) order by task_id desc limit 1

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, error_code, error_message, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where asset_id = #{assetId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) order by task_id desc limit 1

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, request_json, error_code, error_message, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where asset_id = #{assetId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) order by task_id desc limit 1 for update

select count(1) from ai_video_generation_task where asset_id = #{assetId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and status in ('PENDING', 'QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_CALLBACK', 'QUALITY_CHECK', 'RETRYING', 'NEEDS_REVIEW', 'SUBMITTED', 'PROCESSING', 'VALIDATING')
mapper.update:
update ai_video_generation_task
status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_time = now(), completed_time = now(), update_time = now()
where task_id = #{taskId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'RUNNING', progress = 10, error_code = null, error_message = null, worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_expire = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.stageCode', 'PREPARING', '$.stageLabel', '正在准备章节原文和人物规范'), started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'QUEUED' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'PAUSED', request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.stageCode', 'PAUSED', '$.stageLabel', '章节解析已暂停'), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'QUEUED', request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.stageCode', 'QUEUED', '$.stageLabel', '任务已恢复，等待分析线程执行'), error_code = null, error_message = null, recover_count = 0, worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'PAUSED' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set progress = #{progress}, request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.stageCode', #{stageCode}, '$.stageLabel', #{stageLabel}), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_time = now(), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 20, request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.normalizedDurationMs', #{normalizedDurationMs}), error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'QUEUED' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW', progress = 20, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status in ('QUEUED', 'NEEDS_REVIEW') and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'RUNNING', progress = 30, error_code = null, error_message = null, worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_expire = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK' and provider_task_id is not null and (lease_expire is null or lease_expire < now()) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set lease_expire = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and worker_id = #{workerId} and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task
status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage},
completed_time = now(), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null,
update_time = now()
where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW', progress = 20, error_code = 'VIDEO_PROVIDER_SUBMISSION_INTERRUPTED', error_message = '本地进程在确认供应商任务ID前中断，请勿重复提交，需人工核对', update_time = now() where task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'QUEUED' and provider_task_id is null and (retry_count = 0 or retry_count is null) and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 2 minute) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 20, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), update_time = now() where task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'QUEUED' and provider_task_id is not null and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 2 minute) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 30, error_code = 'VIDEO_PROVIDER_POLL_INTERRUPTED', error_message = '上次轮询处理中断，已安全恢复等待状态', worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'RUNNING' and provider_task_id is not null and (lease_expire is null or lease_expire < now()) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'QUEUED' and provider_task_id is null and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 20, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.resolution', json_object( 'action', 'RESUME_WITH_PROVIDER_TASK_ID', 'resolvedBy', #{resolvedBy}, 'resolvedAt', date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'))), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = 'VIDEO_PROVIDER_CONFIRMED_NOT_SUBMITTED', error_message = '人工核对确认供应商未受理，视频草稿已解锁', request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.resolution', json_object( 'action', 'CONFIRM_NOT_SUBMITTED', 'resolvedBy', #{resolvedBy}, 'resolvedAt', date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s'))), completed_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' and provider_task_id is null and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set request_json = #{requestJson}, model_code = #{modelCode}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'QUEUED', provider_task_id = null, progress = 5, model_code = #{modelCode}, request_json = #{requestJson}, retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = null, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = null, completed_time = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and status = 'FAILED' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'RUNNING', progress = 10, error_code = null, error_message = null, worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_expire = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), started_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and json_unquote(json_extract(request_json, '$.trigger')) = 'USER_CONFIRMED' and status = #{expectedStatus} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
and (lease_expire is null or lease_expire < now())

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_time = now(), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and status = #{expectedStatus} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
mapper.select: select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, request_json from ai_video_generation_task where (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and ( (status = 'QUEUED' and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 60 second)) or (status = 'RETRYING' and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 60 second)) or (status = 'RUNNING' and (lease_expire is null or lease_expire < now())) ) order by create_time asc limit 20

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress from ai_video_generation_task where (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK' and provider_task_id is not null order by create_time asc limit 10

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, request_json, error_code, error_message, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where project_id = #{projectId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) order by task_id desc
mapper.update: update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'RUNNING', progress = 5, error_code = null, error_message = null, worker_id = #{workerId}, lease_expire = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), started_time = coalesce(started_time, now()), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'QUEUED' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId}, status = 'WAITING_CALLBACK', progress = 20, request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.normalizedDurationMs', #{normalizedDurationMs}), error_code = null, error_message = null, worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW', progress = 20, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_time = now(), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'QUEUED', progress = 5, provider_task_id = null, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and provider_code = #{providerCode} and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
mapper.select: select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, request_json, error_code, error_message, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and task_type = 'VIDEO' and status = 'QUEUED' and retry_count > 0 and next_retry_time is not null and next_retry_time <= now() order by create_time asc limit #{limit}

select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, request_json, error_code, error_message, recover_count, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'QUEUED' and coalesce(update_time, create_time) < date_sub(now(), interval 60 second) order by create_time asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'QUEUED', progress = 5, error_code = 'STORY_BIBLE_EXECUTION_INTERRUPTED', error_message = '上次执行中断，租约已过期，等待重新执行', request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.stageCode', 'QUEUED', '$.stageLabel', '任务已恢复，等待分析线程执行'), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_expire is not null and lease_expire < now() and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = 'STORY_BIBLE_LEASE_MISSING', error_message = '执行中任务缺少租约（数据异常），已终止防止重复投递', request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.stageCode', 'FAILED', '$.stageLabel', '任务因租约缺失异常终止'), completed_time = now(), worker_id = null, update_time = now() where task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'RUNNING' and lease_expire is null and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set recover_count = recover_count + 1, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'QUEUED' and recover_count < #{maxRecovery} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', progress = 100, error_code = 'STORY_BIBLE_RECOVERY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', error_message = '恢复投递次数达到上限，任务已终止', request_json = json_set(coalesce(request_json, json_object()), '$.stageCode', 'FAILED', '$.stageLabel', '任务因恢复投递超限终止'), completed_time = now(), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'STORY_BIBLE' and status = 'QUEUED' and recover_count >= #{maxRecovery} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'QUEUED', progress = 5, provider_task_id = null, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and status = 'RUNNING' and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
mapper.select: select task_id, project_id, chapter_id, asset_id, task_type, task_name, status, idempotency_key, provider_task_id, progress, request_json, error_code, error_message, create_time from ai_video_generation_task where (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) and task_type = 'IMAGE' and provider_code = 'dashscope' and status = 'QUEUED' and retry_count > 0 and next_retry_time is not null and next_retry_time <= now() order by create_time asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_video_generation_task set callback_event_id = #{eventId}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and (callback_event_id is null or callback_event_id = #{eventId}) and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'CANCELED', progress = 100, completed_time = now(), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RETRYING') and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)

update ai_video_generation_task set status = 'CANCELED', progress = 100, completed_time = now(), worker_id = null, lease_expire = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and task_type = 'VIDEO' and status in ('WAITING_CALLBACK', 'RUNNING') and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
